arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ هَل أَتىٰ عَلَى الإِنسٰنِ حينٌ مِنَ الدَّهرِ لَم يَكُن شَيـًٔا مَذكورًا
transliteration: Hal ata AAala alinsani heenun mina alddahri lam yakun shayan mathkooran
translation: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered

arabic: إِنّا خَلَقنَا الإِنسٰنَ مِن نُطفَةٍ أَمشاجٍ نَبتَليهِ فَجَعَلنٰهُ سَميعًا بَصيرًا
transliteration: Inna khalaqna alinsana min nutfatin amshajin nabtaleehi fajaAAalnahu sameeAAan baseeran
translation: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing

arabic: إِنّا هَدَينٰهُ السَّبيلَ إِمّا شاكِرًا وَإِمّا كَفورًا
transliteration: Inna hadaynahu alssabeela imma shakiran waimma kafooran
translation: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving

arabic: إِنّا أَعتَدنا لِلكٰفِرينَ سَلٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغلٰلًا وَسَعيرًا
transliteration: Inna aAAtadna lilkafireena salasila waaghlalan wasaAAeeran
translation: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire

arabic: إِنَّ الأَبرارَ يَشرَبونَ مِن كَأسٍ كانَ مِزاجُها كافورًا
transliteration: Inna alabrara yashraboona min kasin kana mizajuha kafooran
translation: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur

arabic: عَينًا يَشرَبُ بِها عِبادُ اللَّهِ يُفَجِّرونَها تَفجيرًا
transliteration: AAaynan yashrabu biha AAibadu Allahi yufajjiroonaha tafjeeran
translation: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly

arabic: يوفونَ بِالنَّذرِ وَيَخافونَ يَومًا كانَ شَرُّهُ مُستَطيرًا
transliteration: Yoofoona bialnnathri wayakhafoona yawman kana sharruhu mustateeran
translation: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading

arabic: وَيُطعِمونَ الطَّعامَ عَلىٰ حُبِّهِ مِسكينًا وَيَتيمًا وَأَسيرًا
transliteration: WayutAAimona alttaAAama AAala hubbihi miskeenan wayateeman waaseeran
translation: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him

arabic: إِنَّما نُطعِمُكُم لِوَجهِ اللَّهِ لا نُريدُ مِنكُم جَزاءً وَلا شُكورًا
transliteration: Innama nutAAimukum liwajhi Allahi la nureedu minkum jazaan wala shukooran
translation: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you

arabic: إِنّا نَخافُ مِن رَبِّنا يَومًا عَبوسًا قَمطَريرًا
transliteration: Inna nakhafu min rabbina yawman AAaboosan qamtareeran
translation: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate

arabic: فَوَقىٰهُمُ اللَّهُ شَرَّ ذٰلِكَ اليَومِ وَلَقّىٰهُم نَضرَةً وَسُرورًا
transliteration: Fawaqahumu Allahu sharra thalika alyawmi walaqqahum nadratan wasurooran
translation: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy

arabic: وَجَزىٰهُم بِما صَبَروا جَنَّةً وَحَريرًا
transliteration: Wajazahum bima sabaroo jannatan wahareeran
translation: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire

arabic: مُتَّكِـٔينَ فيها عَلَى الأَرائِكِ لا يَرَونَ فيها شَمسًا وَلا زَمهَريرًا
transliteration: Muttakieena feeha AAala alaraiki la yarawna feeha shamsan wala zamhareeran
translation: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold

arabic: وَدانِيَةً عَلَيهِم ظِلٰلُها وَذُلِّلَت قُطوفُها تَذليلًا
transliteration: Wadaniyatan AAalayhim thilaluha wathullilat qutoofuha tathleelan
translation: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down

arabic: وَيُطافُ عَلَيهِم بِـٔانِيَةٍ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكوابٍ كانَت قَواريرا۠
transliteration: Wayutafu AAalayhim bianiyatin min fiddatin waakwabin kanat qawareera
translation: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass

arabic: قَواريرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّروها تَقديرًا
transliteration: Qawareera min fiddatin qaddarooha taqdeeran
translation: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds)

arabic: وَيُسقَونَ فيها كَأسًا كانَ مِزاجُها زَنجَبيلًا
transliteration: Wayusqawna feeha kasan kana mizajuha zanjabeelan
translation: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil

arabic: عَينًا فيها تُسَمّىٰ سَلسَبيلًا
transliteration: AAaynan feeha tusamma salsabeelan
translation: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil

arabic: وَيَطوفُ عَلَيهِم وِلدٰنٌ مُخَلَّدونَ إِذا رَأَيتَهُم حَسِبتَهُم لُؤلُؤًا مَنثورًا
transliteration: Wayatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona itha raaytahum hasibtahum luluan manthooran
translation: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls

arabic: وَإِذا رَأَيتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيتَ نَعيمًا وَمُلكًا كَبيرًا
transliteration: Waitha raayta thamma raayta naAAeeman wamulkan kabeeran
translation: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate

arabic: عٰلِيَهُم ثِيابُ سُندُسٍ خُضرٌ وَإِستَبرَقٌ وَحُلّوا أَساوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقىٰهُم رَبُّهُم شَرابًا طَهورًا
transliteration: AAaliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun waistabraqun wahulloo asawira min fiddatin wasaqahum rabbuhum sharaban tahooran
translation: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink

arabic: إِنَّ هٰذا كانَ لَكُم جَزاءً وَكانَ سَعيُكُم مَشكورًا
transliteration: Inna hatha kana lakum jazaan wakana saAAyukum mashkooran
translation: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance

arabic: إِنّا نَحنُ نَزَّلنا عَلَيكَ القُرءانَ تَنزيلًا
transliteration: Inna nahnu nazzalna AAalayka alqurana tanzeelan
translation: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation

arabic: فَاصبِر لِحُكمِ رَبِّكَ وَلا تُطِع مِنهُم ءاثِمًا أَو كَفورًا
transliteration: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala tutiAA minhum athiman aw kafooran
translation: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever

arabic: وَاذكُرِ اسمَ رَبِّكَ بُكرَةً وَأَصيلًا
transliteration: Waothkuri isma rabbika bukratan waaseelan
translation: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening

arabic: وَمِنَ الَّيلِ فَاسجُد لَهُ وَسَبِّحهُ لَيلًا طَويلًا
transliteration: Wamina allayli faosjud lahu wasabbihhu laylan taweelan
translation: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night

arabic: إِنَّ هٰؤُلاءِ يُحِبّونَ العاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرونَ وَراءَهُم يَومًا ثَقيلًا
transliteration: Inna haolai yuhibboona alAAajilata wayatharoona waraahum yawman thaqeelan
translation: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day

arabic: نَحنُ خَلَقنٰهُم وَشَدَدنا أَسرَهُم وَإِذا شِئنا بَدَّلنا أَمثٰلَهُم تَبديلًا
transliteration: Nahnu khalaqnahum washadadna asrahum waitha shina baddalna amthalahum tabdeelan
translation: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead

arabic: إِنَّ هٰذِهِ تَذكِرَةٌ فَمَن شاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبيلًا
transliteration: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan
translation: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord

arabic: وَما تَشاءونَ إِلّا أَن يَشاءَ اللَّهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ عَليمًا حَكيمًا
transliteration: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu inna Allaha kana AAaleeman hakeeman
translation: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise

arabic: يُدخِلُ مَن يَشاءُ فى رَحمَتِهِ وَالظّٰلِمينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُم عَذابًا أَليمًا
transliteration: Yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi waalththalimeena aAAadda lahum AAathaban aleeman
translation: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom
